s.note: he knows it isn't real, he eats it anyway
s.how: Cut 600g rump into cubes and season well. Sear hard in a smoking pan in batches, then toss with 40g butter and 2 crushed garlic cloves. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 tsp cracked peppercorns. Serve the bites on toothpicks with the dip.

s.note: the green code falling down the screen
s.how: Blitz a handful of parsley and dill with 2 tbsp flaky salt until green. Brush 3 lavash breads with oil, sprinkle with the herb salt and cut into long thin strips. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp.

m.note: juicy and delicious, real or not
m.how: Dry-brine 4 sirloins overnight. Sear hard, then baste with 50g butter and thyme for a minute and rest. Add 125ml red wine and 250ml stock to the pan and reduce by half, then whisk in a knob of butter. Slice the steak and pour over.

w.note: freshly baked, she knew you'd want one
w.how: Brown 150g butter and cool. Beat with 200g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour, half a tsp bicarb and 200g choc chips. Rest overnight. Roll into 16 balls and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Sprinkle with flaky salt.

d.n: Red pill or blue pill gin fizz
d.note: take the red pill or the blue, choose carefully
d.how: For 2 red drinks, shake 90ml gin, 30ml lemon juice, 30ml raspberry syrup and 60ml cranberry juice with ice and strain into 2 ice-filled glasses. For 2 blue drinks, shake 90ml gin, 30ml lemon juice, 30ml blue curaçao and 15ml sugar syrup with ice and strain into 2 ice-filled glasses. Top all 4 with 80ml soda water and add a lemon wheel.
